name: @psyb0t/predictalot
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted predictalot forecasting API over MCP — zero-shot time-series forecasting plus tabular ML as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running predictalot instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its foundation-model forecasting tools: univariate / multivariate / covariate-aware / sample-path quantile forecasts across 5 zero-shot models (chronos-2, timesfm-2.5, moirai-2, toto-1, sundial-base-128m), plus per-type weighted ensembles and model listings. predictalot is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-predictalot.

PREDICTALOT_URL.description: Base URL of your running predictalot server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

PREDICTALOT_AUTH_TOKENS.description: Bearer token, only if the predictalot server was started with PREDICTALOT_AUTH_TOKENS set.

url.description: Base URL of your running predictalot server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

authToken.description: Bearer token, only if the predictalot server was started with PREDICTALOT_AUTH_TOKENS set.
